title: Kaseya Administrator
description:
**Secure the Technology Behind America's Essential Healthcare Products**

Make your infrastructure expertise essential to healthcare operations. Join Emapta as a
**Kaseya Administrator**
and lead Kaseya VSA X administration, endpoint security, and IT automation for a US pharmaceutical manufacturer. Strengthen system reliability, cybersecurity, and operational continuity while enjoying remote flexibility, international collaboration, professional mentorship, and long-term global career opportunities designed for top 1% talent.

**Job Overview**

* Employment Type: Full-time
* Shift: Night Shift, Weekends Off
* Work Setup: Work From Home/Remote

**Exciting Perks Await!**

* Competitive package
* Medical life insurance
* Work from home arrangement
* Standard government and Emapta benefits
* Well-equipped, modern, and accessible offices
* Employee engagement initiatives
* Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teams
* Diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
* Transparent performance management
* Unlimited upskilling through Emapta Academy courses (Want to know more? Visit:
  **https://emapta.com/training-calendar/**
  )

**The Qualifications We Seek**

Education, Certifications, and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience and certifications may be considered
* **3 to 5 years of hands-on experience administering Kaseya VSA X in a production environment, including platform configuration and ownership beyond technician-level remote support**
* Current Kaseya VSA X Administrator- or Expert-level certification, or an equivalent certification demonstrating advanced platform administration
* Additional Kaseya product certifications strongly preferred

Kaseya Platform and Ecosystem Expertise

* Expert knowledge of
  **Kaseya VSA X**
  **modules**
  , including endpoint management, automation, monitoring, alerting, scripting, patch management, software deployment, inventory, reporting, policy management, integrations, and security administration
* Hands-on experience with
  **IT Glue**
  and at least one Datto product family
* Experience with additional Kaseya solutions, such as KaseyaOne, BMS/Vorex, Autotask PSA, Datto EDR/AV, Datto Endpoint Backup, Datto BCDR, Datto Networking, Spanning Backup, Unitrends, or RapidFire Tools, preferred
* Experience managing large endpoint populations across multiple sites through standardized policies and staged deployments
* Experience using
  **APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, source control, or reporting tools to improve Kaseya workflows and data visibility**
* Experience
  **integrating Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM)**
  platforms with
  **IT Service Management (ITSM)**
  ,
  **Professional Services Automation (PSA)**
  , documentation, security, backup, identity, and business intelligence systems

Systems Administration, Automation, and Security

* Advanced
  **PowerShell**
  scripting skills, including secure script design, parameterization, return-code handling, logging, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of
  **Windows desktop and server administration**
  , i
  **dentity and access management, networking fundamentals, endpoint security, backup and recovery, and IT service management**
* Experience with
  **Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft Intune**
  ,
  **CrowdStrike**
  , vulnerability management platforms, and enterprise email and web security tools
* Knowledge of
  **ITIL practices**
  , formal change control, regulated documentation, validation, audit evidence, and quality system requirements
* Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, ITIL, PowerShell, cybersecurity, backup, or endpoint management certifications preferred

Professional and Collaboration Skills

* Excellent analytical, documentation, communication, and vendor management skills
* Ability to communicate technical risks and operational outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Your Daily Tasks**

Kaseya VSA X Platform Ownership

* Manage the daily administration, configuration, performance, security, and lifecycle of Kaseya VSA X
* Administer VSA X modules for agent deployment, endpoint inventory, system monitoring, alert management, remote management, software deployment, patch management, policy management, reporting, dashboards, workflows, integrations, and role-based access
* Design and maintain organizational structures, device groups, tags, policies, scopes, user roles, permissions, service accounts, and administrative access in accordance with least-privilege principles
* Monitor agent health, check-in status, job execution, alert queues, policy compliance, platform capacity, and integration health; investigate and resolve exceptions
* Administer Windows endpoints and servers through VSA X, with support for macOS and Linux environments where applicable
* Maintain secure administrative practices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), separate privileged accounts, auditable changes, credential protection, and documented emergency access procedures

Automation, Scripting, and Process Improvement

* Design, test, document, deploy, and maintain VSA X automations and workflows for recurring operational tasks
* Develop and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts, batch scripts, command-line tools, APIs, webhooks, and other automation components within Kaseya
* Automate software deployment and removal, configuration enforcement, service remediation, vulnerability remediation, local administrator cleanup, health checks, asset data collection, disk space cleanup, agent repair, alert triage, and scheduled maintenance
* Implement automation safeguards, including pilot groups, pre-deployment checks, activity logs, controlled rollouts, failure management, rollback procedures, change records, and post-deployment validation
* Identify repetitive tasks and control gaps, establish performance baselines, implement workflow improvements, and report measurable outcomes, such as time savings, faster remediation, fewer failed jobs, improved compliance, and reduced ticket volume
* Maintain a version-controlled script and automation library with documented purposes, owners, dependencies, parameters, test evidence, approval status, and recovery instructions

Patching, Monitoring, and Endpoint Operations

* Configure and maintain operating system and third-party application patch policies, maintenance windows, approval rules, deployment rings, reboot behavior, exclusions, and exception procedures
* Review patch and configuration compliance, investigate deployment failures, coordinate remediation, and prepare management-ready status reports
* Develop actionable monitoring policies and alert thresholds to reduce unnecessary alerts while maintaining visibility into critical services, security events, backup conditions, and endpoint health
* Coordinate upgrades to agents, platform features, integrations, scripts, policies, and related components through documented tests and change management procedures
* Support incident response and problem management through endpoint telemetry, remote access, audit histories, automation evidence, and corrective actions

Kaseya Ecosystem and Integrations

* Administer and optimize IT Glue, including user and access management, security controls, documentation standards, configurations, flexible assets, relationships, integrations, exports, and documentation quality reviews
* Administer or support relevant Datto solutions, including Datto Endpoint Backup, Datto BCDR, Datto EDR/AV, and Datto Networking, with responsibility for deployment, system monitoring, alert reviews, restore validation, incident response, and reporting
* Configure and maintain integrations between VSA X and Kaseya ecosystem products, including IT Glue, Datto, KaseyaOne, BMS/Vorex, Autotask PSA, and other licensed solutions
* Validate data synchronization, organization and device mapping, alert-to-ticket workflows, remote-control access, password and documentation access, and data integrity across integrated platforms
* Evaluate additional Kaseya modules and capabilities, assess business value and risks, and lead approved implementations

Documentation, Governance, and Collaboration

* Develop and maintain platform architecture documentation, technical standards, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, support procedures, inventories, change records, upgrade plans, and recovery procedures
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, service desk, application, quality, and business teams to translate operational requirements into sustainable Kaseya policies and workflows
* Train IT personnel on platform administration, automation safety, troubleshooting procedures, documentation standards, and effective use of integrated Kaseya products
* Manage vendor escalations, track defects and enhancement requests, and communicate operational risks, project status, and recommendations to IT leadership
* Support software licensing, renewal plans, utilization reviews, and cost optimization across the Kaseya product portfolio

Physical Requirements

* Remain seated for extended periods while performing computer-based tasks
* Use hands and fingers frequently to type and operate standard office equipment
* Stand, walk, bend, and reach occasionally as required

**About the Client**

Our client is
**a leading US pharmaceutical manufacturer, packager, and distributor specializing in over-the-counter medicines and consumer healthcare products.**
Established in 1988, they provide private-label pharmaceutical solutions to major retailers nationwide. Their expertise spans product development, manufacturing, packaging, quality assurance, and distribution, with offerings across pain relief, allergy care, digestive health, and wellness. Through advanced facilities, regulatory compliance, innovative technology, and rigorous quality standards, they deliver safe, affordable, and accessible healthcare products that support healthier communities and improve everyday lives across America.

**Join the Top 1% Talent. A Better Career. A Better Life.**

Join us at Emapta, and let your professional journey flourish in the heart of India's vibrant culture!

Recognized as one of Asia's rising tech and outsourcing destinations, we offer a wealth of opportunities to showcase your talent to the world. At Emapta, we connect you with global clients, giving you international exposure without leaving the comfort of your home country. With
**over 1,200 international clients**
and a decade of proven success, we provide a strong foundation for your career growth. Here, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning are part of everyday life, and work-life balance is more than just a promise-it's a reality.

**#EmaptaEra #EmaptaIndia**

title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

* Deep Expertise Development: Cultivate an in-depth understanding of Confluent’s technologies and the intricacies of building streaming applications.
* Technical Discovery and POC/Pilot Solutions: Collaborate with Confluent solutions engineers to gather requirements, identify use cases, and facilitate the development of Proof of Concept (POC)/Pilot solutions. Aid customers in overcoming technical challenges during initial blueprinting and use case deployment.
* Prospect Demos and Evangelization: Collaborate seamlessly with Confluent's Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to bring our offerings to new prospects. Craft and deliver tailored demos that go beyond the standard, showcasing the unique value proposition Confluent has to offer.
* Customer Engagement: Offer technical assistance in driving customer consumption through monthly customer health reports, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Quarterly Technical Reviews.
* Knowledge Sharing, Workshops, and Training: Support cross-functional teams, including Field Marketing, Partner Solutions by conducting training sessions and workshops/webinars for customers, partners, prospects, and internal teams to educate them on Confluent's platform/cloud, features, and best practices.
* RFP/Vendor risk assessment Support: Contribute to vendor risk assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of potential risks and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Assist in answering Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs).
* Technical Artifact Creation and Maintenance: Architect, build, and maintain reusable artifacts, including tools, prototypes, demos, workshops, and architecture blueprints.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre-sales capacity.
* Process & Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.
  
  

* First-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment & Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering & Integration).
* Clear, consistent demonstration of self-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must
* Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities to all levels across an organization.
* Ability to explain complex concepts in plain, non-technical language that resonates with mid-level managers and business owners.
* Fluency in English is a requisite.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Previous experience building solutions with Apache Kafka.
* Understanding of systems operations concepts (disk, network, operating systems, etc).
* Experience with software development tools, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus
* Experience building and operating large scale systems.
* Experience in technical pre-sales or consultative roles.

* Lead SAP Solution Manager (SolMan) and SAP Cloud ALM initiatives, including developing and executing a strategic roadmap, driving new functionalities, and managing upgrades.
* Partner with governance, functional, and technical teams to improve and execute SolMan offerings effectively.
* Act as the product owner for Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM managing sprints, backlogs, and product priorities.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for operational execution, troubleshooting, and support, including leading and participating in projects, minor/major releases, and reviewing system-related tickets for accuracy and priority.

* Good knowledge of Focused Run, Focused Insights, and SAP Basis.

title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Windows
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

**Job Description**

Position Title: L3 Operations Senior Compute Engineer
  
  
Reporting To: Compute Service Operations Lead, Environment Testing Europe
  
  
Working Location: Coimbatore
  
  
Shift Timing: 12PM – 9PM IST
  
  
  
  
  
  
OVERALL OBJECTIVES:

As part of the IT Infrastructure Support Team for Eurofins Environment Testing Europe, you will join a growing international team to work on maintenance of newly deployed segregated IT User Zones and Application Availability Groups Cloud infrastructure. Your role will be to support daily Compute operations tasks in a complex hybrid environment in Azure Cloud and local HyperV infrastructure. You will collaborate with number of different IT Support and Delivery Teams on daily basis. It will require strong Azure & HyperV virtualization, AD, Security and Networking skills. Open mind and ability to cooperate with multiple individuals in a multicultural environment is essential.
  
  
  
  
You will get an opportunity to drive Eurofins major IT Infrastructure transition and transformation across Environment Testing Europe Businesses.
  
  
  
  
SPECIFIC ASSIGNMENTS:
  
  
  
  
  
  
Manage, maintain and optimize Azure compute services as well as on-premises Hyper-V clusters and virtual machine infrastructure
  
  
Implement automation and orchestration for deployment, scaling, and management using PowerShell
  
  
Monitor compute infrastructure health, troubleshoot incidents, and execute root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
  
  
Collaborate with cloud architects, network, and security teams, as well as application owners at the international corporate level to support compute capacity planning and optimization and best meet business requirements in terms of security, cost, and effectiveness
  
  
Enforce security best practices and compliance requirements in cloud and on-prem environments
  
  
Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for both Azure and Hyper-V platforms
  
  
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the compute operations team
  
  
Maintain detailed documentation of operational procedures, configurations, and workflows
  
  
Stay current with environment version updates, emerging technologies, and industry best practices
  
  
  
  
  
  
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  
  
  
An ideal candidate should have strong experience in all of the below:
  
  
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  
  
5+ years managing compute infrastructure with strong focus on Microsoft technologies.
  
  
Deep expertise in managing Hyper-V environments including failover clustering, live migration, and storage management.
  
  
Solid understanding of Windows Server administration and networking fundamentals.
  
  
Experience in administering and maintaining print server environments, as well as troubleshooting printing‑related issues in Windows environments.
  
  
Experience with backup and disaster recovery strategies for both cloud and on-premises environments (preferably in Veeam backup environments).
  
  
Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
  
  
Ability to read, understand and create technical documentation
  
  
Very good command of English written and spoken
  
  
Ability to present technical projects on meetings
  
  
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure compute services

title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: DE - Cloud - Senior Data Platform Engineer - GDSN02
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Data Platform Engineer**

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure security best practices: manage secrets, network isolation, encryption, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and ML teams to enable seamless integration and workflow automation.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices: integrate security scanning and compliance checks into DataOps/MLOps pipelines.

* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), including networking, IAM, and cost management.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep) and automation scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell).

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive platform adoption.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and integrating security tools into data pipelines.
* Ability to mentor and upskill teams on Databricks, DataOps, and MLOps best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to assess risks and propose mitigation strategies.
* Experience with regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in cloud data environments is a plus.
* Capability to identify software packages and solutions that could meet client solution requirements and develop requests for proposal (RFP’s) from these vendors. Assist clients in the evaluation of the resulting proposals, including the package capabilities and fit to the requirements (business and technology), vendor proposals for pricing and support.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/B.Tech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4 to 8 years
* Cloud Computing knowledge in multi cloud environments (Azure, AWS)

* Strong understanding of DataOps and MLOps practices, including orchestration, monitoring, and governance
* Hands-on experience with containerization, including Docker & Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE)

**Preferred Skills**

title: Vice President - Product Engineering
description:
**Role: Vice President — Product Engineering**
**Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore**
**About AppViewX:**
AppViewX is trusted by the world’s leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry’s most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
  
  

* **We Do What We Say:**
  We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:**
  We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:**
  We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:**
  We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
  
  
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering — and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
***Engineering Leadership & Culture***

* Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture.
* Set and champion engineering best practices — including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence — across all teams.
* Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership.
* Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning — rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work.

***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams.
* Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
* Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance — to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery.
* Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale.

***Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices — including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools — to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle.
* Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities — including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks — into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line.
* Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap.
* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

***Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

**What We Require**
***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration — including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles — including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization.
* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.
* Strong command of software engineering best practices — coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations.
* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

**Why AppViewX?**
AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
  
  
AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

Staff DevOps Engineer / Cloud Platform Architect with expertise in Azure Cloud, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps).
  
  
The ideal candidate will lead enterprise cloud transformation, build scalable cloud-native platforms, modernize CI/CD processes, and implement AI-driven operational capabilities to improve system reliability, observability, incident response, and infrastructure efficiency.

**2. Platform Engineering & CI/CD Modernization**

- Establish enterprise SDLC standards, branching strategies, and release governance.

title: IT Lead -IT Engineering
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Lead -IT Engineering

**Location:**
Bangalore/ Coimbatore

**Immediate joiners or notice period of less than 30 days are needed**

**This Role:**

The IT Lead, IT Engineering leads the engineering of LogixHealth's Microsoft cloud and workplace platforms: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Azure including Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Purview data protection, ITSM tooling and automation. The role owns everything beyond day-to-day operations in a healthcare technology environment that handles Protected Health Information (PHI).

This is a strategic and technical leadership role. The Lead sets the standards and roadmap for these platforms, is the technical authority on design decisions and major incidents, stays hands-on for the most complex work, and leads and mentors the IT engineers who deliver the rest. The Lead turns business and security requirements into a practical platform plan with costs, risks and timelines for the IT Infrastructure Leadership, and serves all LogixHealth locations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Strategy, Standards and Roadmap***

* Own the architecture, design standards and 12 to 24 month roadmap for identity, endpoint management, data protection, cloud and virtual desktop and IT tooling; translate business, security and compliance requirements into options and investment cases with cost, risk and timeline.
* Provide input to budgeting, Azure forecasts, Microsoft licensing and tooling decisions; lead projects end to end (requirements, design, pilot, phased rollout, handover) and act as technical approver in design and change reviews.

***Platform Ownership (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Azure, AVD)***

* Own Entra ID standards: Conditional Access framework, MFA and authentication strategy, Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, application integration and hybrid identity (Entra Connect).
* Own endpoint and data protection standards: Autopilot, Autopatch, configuration and compliance policies, Defender for Endpoint, application deployment, Purview DLP and encryption, for Windows and macOS.
* Own Azure Virtual Desktop design and operation (host pools, image strategy, FSLogix, autoscaling, capacity, cost and monitoring) and the supporting Azure resources.

***Security Hardening, Patch and Vulnerability Management***

* Own the hardening standard (Microsoft or CIS baselines, Defender for Endpoint and ASR rules, Credential Guard, firewall, device control, encryption, Windows LAPS) and the patch programme: policy and SLAs by severity, monthly cycle, third-party patching, maintenance windows, exception governance and zero-day response.
* Own the vulnerability management programme: intake from Defender Vulnerability Management or scanners, prioritisation, remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance register with Security, verified closure and monthly posture reporting with owners and dates for gaps.

***ITSM Tooling and Automation***

* Own the engineering of IT tooling, including ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus design and its integrations with Intune, Entra ID and Microsoft 365, plus monitoring, reporting and self-service automation.
* Set automation and documentation standards for the team (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure DevOps or Git) and introduce Infrastructure as Code where it adds value.

***Incident, Compliance and Team Leadership***

* Act as technical lead on major incidents affecting these platforms and on the technical response to security incidents with Information Security; manage Microsoft and vendor escalations; own ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence for the platform controls.
* Lead, mentor and develop the IT engineering team: allocate work, review designs, provide escalation support and build capability across the platforms.

**Qualifications:**

The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties.

***Required (Mandatory):***

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.
* 9 to 12 years in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2 to 3 years as technical lead, with at least 4 years hands-on on Microsoft 365 and Azure in a design and build (engineering) capacity rather than support-only roles.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access design, MFA and authentication methods, PIM, access reviews, enterprise application SSO and hybrid identity.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune: Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, Autopatch or update rings, Defender for Endpoint, macOS management.
* Strong hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop: architecture, host pools, image lifecycle, FSLogix, autoscaling, security and monitoring, with working knowledge of the Azure platform (networking, storage, monitoring, RBAC, cost).
* Proven ownership of patch and vulnerability management for an endpoint or VDI estate: hardening standards, Defender Vulnerability Management or Tenable, Rapid7 or Qualys, SLA-based remediation, exception governance and reporting.
* PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; proven ability to define a roadmap, lead major incidents, run design reviews and explain architecture, cost and risk to senior management.
* Work from office; shifts and on-call as required for a 24×7 healthcare operation; travel between Coimbatore and Bangalore when needed.

***Preferred (Good to Have):***

* Infrastructure as Code: owning a Terraform (azurerm, azuread) or Bicep practice with module standards, remote state, Git pull-request workflow, pipeline deployment and drift detection, including identity objects managed as code.
* Deeper Azure platform design (vNets, NSGs, private endpoints, Azure Files, Compute Gallery, Log Analytics) and Azure DevOps or GitHub CI/CD; Windows 365, Nerdio, Citrix or VMware Horizon to AVD migration.
* Microsoft Purview DLP and Defender XDR depth; ITSM tool design or integration (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceNow or similar); experience moving from AD-dependent estates to cloud-native Entra ID and Intune; healthcare, HIPAA or other regulated environment.

***Preferred Certifications (Good to Have):***

Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, MD-102, SC-300, AZ-140; ITIL Foundation; HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

Our team brings together engineers and leaders who have built and scaled products at organizations like Google, NetApp, ADP, Cognizant Consulting, and Capgemini.

**DevOps Lead**
who can own cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, reliability, and engineering practices for modern software and AI-enabled platforms. **Experience -**
10+ Years
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation, and operation of scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.
* Own DevOps strategy and technical direction across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automation, and production operations.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and AI-enabled workloads across development, staging, and production.
* Design and manage Kubernetes environments using AKS, EKS, Docker, and Helm.

* Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud costs while maintaining reliability and scalability.
* Evaluate and introduce DevOps tools and practices that improve engineering productivity and deployment quality.
* Mentor DevOps engineers and provide technical leadership across projects and teams.

* Cloud Specialist: Deep hands-on expertise in either AWS or Azure. You do not need to be an expert in both.

* Opportunity to lead production-grade cloud and AI-enabled platforms for global clients

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation, and operation of scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.
* Own DevOps strategy and technical direction across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automation, and production operations.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and AI-enabled workloads across development, staging, and production.

* Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud costs while maintaining reliability and scalability.
* Evaluate and introduce DevOps tools and practices that improve engineering productivity and deployment quality.
* Mentor DevOps engineers and provide technical leadership across projects and teams.

**What We're Looking For Beyond Skills**

* **Cloud Specialist:**
  Deep hands-on expertise in either AWS or Azure. You do not need to be an expert in both.
* **Strong DevOps Foundation:**
  Proven experience owning CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, containers, automation, and production operations.
* **AI Exposure:**
  Experience working with or supporting AI/ML, GenAI, LLM, or AI-enabled applications and an understanding of their infrastructure needs.
* **Builder Mindset:**
  Ability to design, implement, and improve systems rather than only manage existing environments.
* **Ownership:**
  Willingness to take responsibility for reliability, delivery, security, and operational excellence.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to mentor engineers, drive technical decisions, and work effectively with engineering and product teams.
* **Location & Availability:**
  Willingness to work onsite from the Coimbatore office and availability to join immediately or at short notice.

**Good to Have**

* Experience supporting AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM or AI-agent based applications in production. • Experience with GitOps and Argo CD.
* Experience with cloud security, governance, networking and enterprise landing zones. • Experience with blue/green, canary and automated rollback strategies.
* Experience with Python-based automation or AI integrations.
* Experience with FinOps and optimization of cloud infrastructure costs.
* Relevant AWS, Azure or Kubernetes certifications.

**What we offer**

* Competitive compensation
* Coimbatore office-based role with a strong engineering environment
* Opportunity to lead production-grade cloud and AI-enabled platforms for global clients
* Exposure to modern AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, DevOps and AI engineering practices
* Paid holidays & flexible time off
* Medical insurance (Self & Family, up to ₹4 Lakhs per person)
* A culture that values clarity, integrity and continuous growth

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
  
  
**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**

* Lead the administration and advanced support of the CyberArk PAM solution, including complex troubleshooting, policy management, and platform optimization.
* Design and implement enhancements to the CyberArk infrastructure to improve security, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.
* Oversee the onboarding of new accounts, platforms, and integrations into the CyberArk environment, ensuring adherence to strict security guidelines.
* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.
* Proven experience in managing complex CyberArk environments, including components such as EPV, CPM, PSM, and AIM.
* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

**Work Requirements:**

* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

 Architecture
   

  

 \* Design the end\-to\-end architecture for the Semantic Governance Platform.
   

 \* Define application, data, integration, semantic and AI architecture.
   

 \* Design the canonical semantic registry and concept/version model.
   

 \* Define architecture for ontology and knowledge\-graph components.
   

 \* Design workflow architecture for proposal, review, approval, escalation and deprecation.
   

 \* Define APIs and integration patterns for enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Data \& Semantic Architecture
   

  

 \* Design semantic models for business concepts, relationships, formulas and dependencies.
   

 \* Define metadata, lineage and provenance architecture.
   

 \* Design mechanisms for identifying conflicting definitions.
   

 \* Define semantic impact\-analysis architecture.
   

 \* Establish standards for canonical definitions and version management.
   

  

 AI Architecture
   

  

 \* Design AI/LLM components for:
   

 \* Semantic similarity
   

 \* Concept matching
   

 \* Conflict detection
   

 \* Regulatory document analysis
   

 \* Impact analysis
   

 \* AI\-assisted governance
   

 \* Define appropriate use of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG and knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop controls so AI recommendations do not automatically become authoritative definitions.
   

 \* Define evaluation, explainability and guardrail mechanisms.
   

  

 Enterprise Integration
   

  

 Design integration patterns with:
   

  

 \* Snowflake
   

 \* Databricks
   

 \* Power BI
   

 \* Tableau
   

 \* Collibra / Alation
   

 \* Data catalogs
   

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs
   

 \* Existing Claims, Underwriting and Finance systems
   

  

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 \* Create HLD and LLD architecture documentation.
   

 \* Produce architecture diagrams using Draw.io, Lucidchart or Mermaid.
   

 \* Create API, integration and data\-flow specifications.
   

 \* Participate in technical discussions with client stakeholders.
   

 \* Guide engineering teams during implementation.
   

 \* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks.
   

 \* Make technology and architectural trade\-off decisions.
   

  

 Required Technical Skills
   

  

 Must Have:
   

  

 \* 8\+ years of enterprise solution architecture experience.
   

 \* Strong experience with data platforms and enterprise integration.
   

 \* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Metadata Management.
   

 \* Experience with cloud architecture — AWS, Azure or GCP.
   

 \* Strong SQL and data architecture knowledge.
   

 \* REST APIs and event\-driven architecture.
   

 \* Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
   

 \* Experience integrating BI platforms such as Power BI/Tableau.
   

 \* Understanding of ontology, semantic models or knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture and LLM\-based applications.
   

 \* Experience with security, RBAC and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have:
   

  

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.
   

 \* RAG and vector databases.
   

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.
   

 \* Insurance, Banking, Financial Services or Risk domain experience.
   

  

 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Solution Architect will be responsible for producing:
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture
   

 2\. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
   

 3\. High\-Level Architecture (HLD)
   

 4\. Low\-Level Architecture (LLD)
   

 5\. Semantic/Knowledge Graph Architecture
   

 6\. AI/LLM Architecture
   

 7\. Integration Architecture
   

 8\. Security Architecture
   

 9\. API Architecture
   

 10\. Data Flow \& Sequence Diagrams
   

 11\. Deployment Architecture
   

 12\. Technology Selection \& Trade\-off Analysis
   

 13\. POC Architecture
   

 14\. Implementation Roadmap
   

 15\. Technical Standards for Engineering Teams
   

  

 Key Question We Expect the Architect to Solve
   

  

 The architect should be able to answer:
   

  

 How do we take an approved business definition such as “Loss Ratio”, represent it as a canonical semantic object, map it to regulatory requirements, detect conflicting implementations in Snowflake/Power BI/ML systems, perform impact analysis when the definition changes, and propagate the approved version across the enterprise — while keeping humans accountable for the final decision?
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can operate at both levels:
   

  

 Business → Architecture → Engineering
   

  

 and can confidently sit with:
   

  

 CDO / CFO / CRO → Data Governance → Enterprise Architects → Data Scientists → Data Engineers → Developers
   

  

 and convert the business requirement into an executable technical architecture.

title: GDS Cyber - DPP - Senior - AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Staff Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Staff Engineer to lead more complex engineering work across AI\-enabled data protection deployments, with a stronger emphasis on automation, reusable assets, and hybrid/agentic deployment patterns. This role builds on the field engineer foundation by adding greater solution depth, stronger technical ownership, and the ability to operationalize scalable patterns that can be reused across multiple client environments. The internal role matrix specifically places this level at “above field engineer \+ agentic hybrid deployment, automate.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the engineering design and implementation of advanced data protection solutions spanning discovery/classification, protection controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and rights management capabilities in AI\-enabled enterprise environments.
* Build and industrialize automation for deployment, policy tuning, control validation, reporting, and operational workflows using scripting, APIs, and engineering tooling. The internal frontier AI materials also identify automation\-oriented assets such as smart classification and data map, rapid policy config deployer, and triage orchestrator as target capabilities for the adaptive data protection pillar.
* Design and deploy hybrid and agentic patterns that bring together data protection platforms, AI tools, and enterprise data/workflow integrations while maintaining security, privacy, and control effectiveness.
* Own technical workstreams in client engagements, including design decisions, engineering quality, integration approaches, troubleshooting of complex issues, and stabilization planning.
* Create reusable accelerators such as prompts, engineering patterns, code libraries, configuration baselines, implementation templates, and testing artifacts to improve delivery speed and consistency across the practice. Comparable FDE and AI engineering roles explicitly emphasize reusable frameworks and reference implementations.
* Mentor junior engineers and help uplift practice capability through code reviews, knowledge transfer, technical coaching, and contribution to internal engineering standards.
* Work across data protection, AI engineering, privacy, and cloud teams to ensure solutions are operationally sound, scalable, and aligned with client architecture and compliance requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5–8 years of experience in data protection engineering, cybersecurity engineering, privacy engineering, cloud security engineering, or adjacent domains.
* Strong hands\-on experience with data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with the ability to apply these concepts in production\-oriented delivery contexts.
* Experience with one or more major data protection ecosystems such as Microsoft Purview, Cyera, Varonis, Sentra, CrowdStrike Falcon DSPM, or Wiz DSPM.
* Strong scripting/integration skills in Python, plus experience with APIs, cloud services, and engineering toolchains.
* Ability to independently lead technical workstreams in ambiguous, client\-facing delivery environments. Comparable customer\-facing AI engineering roles strongly emphasize production\-grade delivery, communication, and end\-to\-end ownership.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with automated policy deployment, classification engineering, data mapping, or AI\-enabled triage/orchestration patterns.
* Familiarity with privacy and cross\-border data transfer considerations in AI use cases. Internal guidance explicitly highlights the importance of permissions, personal data handling, and cross\-border processing when AI systems use enterprise data.
* Experience contributing to internal assets, managed services, or engineering standards within a professional services or product engineering environment.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

* Typical work environment
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Must\-Have**

* Strong hands\-on experience with

* Direct ownership of DevOps systems powering enterprise AI deployments
* Competitive salary and career growth opportunities
